title: New arenas, districts and pending deals

rows.public_construction_notes: Option agreements on ~104 acres of the former Valley View Mall (June 2026); Legends hired as owner rep; no public financing deal reported; site lies in the Mall Area Redevelopment TIF district.

Included in MEM row. PENDING: held until long-term lease; the Oct 8 2026 Sports Authority agenda lists the CMAR agreement and a funding-agreement amendment, and press reports their approval; lease unsigned as of Oct 16 2026

rows.arena: New Oklahoma City arena (Continental Coliseum, Paycom Center replacement)
rows.opened: late summer 2028 (target); must open by June 2029
rows.public_construction_notes: 72-month 1-cent sales tax (voters Dec 2023, 71%; projected $976.3M incl. debt service) + MAPS 4: $89M (okc.gov 2026-10-12); $78M (b, OCPPA audited FY2024 report: "City MAPS 4 | Arena | 78,000,000"; okc.gov 2026-03-26; Bond Buyer 2025-10-16); ~$99M (Bond Buyer 2026-05-19); $70M (earlier okc.gov). Public = $900M arena (okc.gov 2026-03-26) - Thunder $50M (computed). $777.15M Series 2026 Arena Sales Tax Revenue Bonds (June 2026; Moody's rated a proposed $800.6M). Bond Buyer (2026-05-19) also reports a temporary 1% use tax approved in December (year not stated; not verified) and pledged revenue of $1.18B. OUTSIDE THE ARENA BUDGET: 2025 GO bonds approved by voters Oct 14 2025 (Prop 5 75.52%, Prop 9 75.95%): $35M downtown garage replacing the Myriad parking facility (b, vision.okc.gov, which lists it without naming the arena; the arena link is from Bond Buyer, c) + $25M Thunder front-office buildout (c, Oklahoma Gazette; city lists the line without an amount). Bond Buyer (2026-05-19): $90M of 2025 GO allocated to arena parking, streets and team offices (alternative). Earlier ledger text dated this vote Oct 14 2026 and called it pending; corrected Oct 16 2026.
rows.lease_terms: 25 years from move-in, through at least 2053 (Bond Buyer 2026-04-06); early-exit penalties > $1B (KGOU 2025)

rows.public_construction_notes: Teams call it "the largest fully privately funded project in city history" (Sept 2026 renderings); needs City Council approvals; Gov. Shapiro said (Jan 2025) he would review whether the state invests - no decision found.

Same money as the POR row pending renovation (not double counted). PENDING: State up to $365M (SB 1501, enacted, conditional; bond sale expected spring 2027 per DAS) + County up to $88M + City up to $120M (term sheet approved Aug 12 2026, non-binding) = $573M; plus ongoing money (city up to $275.0M over 20 years, county $13.6M) not counted; definitive documents due by Dec 31 2026; no action found Oct 12-16 2026

Bexar County Prop B (Nov 2025, 52.1%): venue tax (hotel 1.75%->2% + 5% car rental) up to $311M. PENDING: City up to $489M under a non-binding term sheet (Aug 2025, 7-4); council declined on Aug 17 2026 (5-6) to put the $489M to voters in Nov 2026; separately, council approved Sept 10 2026 up to $60M of Midtown TIRZ debt to buy the 13-acre arena site (more than $115M with financing; final financing plan to return to council; KSAT, TPR); definitive agreements targeted by Dec 31 2026, not signed as of Oct 16 2026
$375M of the ~$900M 0.5% SLC sales-tax bonds for the surrounding district (not the arena); PID board majority SEG appointees.

rows.arena: Capital One Arena purchase + renovation (2024 deal)
rows.public_construction_notes: $87.5M purchase + $427.5M renovation; included in WAS row.

method: select p.team, p.arena, p.city, p.opened, p.owner, p.row_type, p.construction_cost_nominal_m, p.construction_cost_label, p.public_construction_nominal_m, p.public_renovation_pending_nominal_m, p.private_construction_nominal_m, p.public_construction_notes, p.lease_terms, p.notes_and_gaps, coalesce((select list(s.source_id order by s.field, s.ord) from arena_sources s where s.row_type = p.row_type and s.team = p.team), []) as sources from ledger p where p.row_type like 'project%' order by p.team
